user.title: EV smart charge plan
user.description: Pick the car's battery sensor (%) and one or more electricity price sensors that carry a price list in their attributes (e.g. Strømligning, Nord Pool or Energi Data Service). Charger control is optional.

data_description.car_device: Pick the car's device: its battery and plug sensors and its name are filled in automatically. Add the integration once per car; several cars can share one charger.
data_description.battery_entity: Filled in from the car when left empty.
data_description.charger_type: Without charger control the integration only calculates the plan.
data_description.zaptec_mode_entity: The charger's "Charger mode" sensor from the Zaptec integration. The charging switch and the authorise button on the same charger are found automatically.
data_description.charge_switch: A switch that starts (on) and stops (off) charging, e.g. from OCPP, Monta or Easee.
data_description.car_plugged_entity: The car's own plug sensor. When it is off, another car is at the charger and the charger is left alone.
data_description.vehicle_model: Automatic picks the Tesla model from the car's device and its range. Other car: enter the capacity below.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Leave empty to use the chosen model's capacity.

error.not_numeric: The sensor does not have a numeric state.
error.no_prices: None of the sensors has a price list in its attributes.
error.required_for_zaptec: Pick the Zaptec charger mode sensor.
error.zaptec_switch_missing: No charging switch was found on this Zaptec charger.
error.battery_required: Pick the car or its battery level sensor.
